hotels.title: Ubud Adults-Only Pool Villa Luxury with Rainforest Infinity Pool
hotels.description: Hidden deep in Bali’s lush jungle, this secluded retreat is an adults-only sanctuary designed for ultimate tranquillity. Surrounded by misty mountains, emerald rice fields and tropical greenery, this resort boasts a 36-degree heated pool and personalised butler service, ideal for couples seeking privacy, romance and relaxation. Each ultra-luxurious private pool villa includes open-air living spaces that blend seamlessly with nature, offering breathtaking valley views and total serenity. Foodies will rejoice at the delectable dishes served up at Jihwa Restaurant, a romantic hideaway among the trees. Sip on cocktails, indulge in a blissful massage at Hara Wellness, or unwind with wellness-focused activities like meditation, village walks and Balinese dance lessons. Immerse yourself in authentic Balinese culture while enjoying the finest in boutique luxury.
